shortDescription: QALA FOR FINANCIAL INVESTMENTS SAE EGX:CCAP:

children: QALAA HOLDINGS- BOARD APPROVES PURCHASE OF AN ADDITIONAL STAKE IN EGYPTIAN REFINING COMPANY
QALAA HOLDINGS- DOUBLING QALAA’S ACTUAL INDIRECT STAKE IN EGYPTIAN REFINING CO FROM 13.0% TO 27.1%
QALAA HOLDINGS- BOARD APPROVES A 55.4% SHAREHOLDING IN NEW AGE REFINING LTD, WHICH WILL BUY ALL THE SHARES OF QPI EGYPT LTD FROM QATAR ENERGY
QALAA HOLDINGS-  FINANCIAL CLOSING OF TRANSACTION IS EXPECTED TO BE COMPLETED IN DECEMBER, 2026
QALAA HOLDINGS- BOARD ALSO APPROVES INCREASING CAPITAL OF QALAA HOLDINGS THROUGH A CASH INCREASE FOR EXISTING SHAREHOLDERS
QALAA HOLDINGS- RAISING PAID-UP CAPITAL FROM C. EGP 21.1 BILLION TO EGP 25 BILLION
QALAA HOLDINGS- CAPITAL INCREASE WILL BE USED TO PURCHASE ADDITIONAL INDIRECT STAKE IN EGYPTIAN REFINING CO
QALAA HOLDINGS- CAPITAL INCREASE WILL BE USED TO PAY CO'S FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS TO ARAB INTERNATIONAL BANK, SEVERAL EGYPTIAN BANKS AND OTHERS
QALAA HOLDINGS- INCREASE WILL ALSO BE USED TO ACTIVATE AN INITIAL PART OF QALAA HOLDINGS' RIGHT TO REPURCHASE SHARES OF TAQA ARABIA
QALAA HOLDINGS- AIMS TO COMPLETE CAPITAL INCREASE PROCEDURES BEFORE MID-DECEMBER 2026
QALAA HOLDINGS- APPOINTS GRAVITON FINANCIAL ADVISORY AS INDEPENDENT FINANCIAL ADVISOR TO PREPARE FAIR VALUE STUDY FOR CO’S SHARE PRICE
